name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: Where the user is in a hierarchy, as a trail of links: a <nav> with an ordered list of links, the current place, separators and an ellipsis for collapsed items, on Base UI's useRender.

manifest.name: breadcrumb
manifest.title: Breadcrumb
manifest.description: Where the user is in a hierarchy, as a trail of links: a <nav> with an ordered list of links, the current place, separators and an ellipsis for collapsed items, on Base UI's useRender.
manifest.usage: Use Breadcrumb to show and move up a path: connection, schema, table, column; a settings section. Compose it as Breadcrumb > BreadcrumbList > BreadcrumbItem (BreadcrumbLink with href, or render a router link) with BreadcrumbSeparator between items, and BreadcrumbPage for the last, current place. Collapse a long middle into BreadcrumbEllipsis inside a DropdownMenuTrigger listing the hidden places. It is not a substitute for navigation: use Sidebar or NavigationMenu for that; for steps of a task, Stepper.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Breadcrumb: the name of the <nav> landmark.

props.name: render
props.description: BreadcrumbLink: a router link instead of <a>.

props.name: children
props.description: BreadcrumbSeparator: a custom mark ("/"); a chevron by default.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: A navigation landmark named Breadcrumb; data-slot="breadcrumb".

parts.name: BreadcrumbList
parts.description: An <ol> that wraps on narrow widths, in color.fg.muted.

parts.name: BreadcrumbItem
parts.description: An <li> holding a link, the page or an ellipsis.

parts.name: BreadcrumbLink
parts.description: An <a> (or render) in color.fg.muted, underlined and color.fg.default on hover, truncated when long.

parts.name: BreadcrumbPage
parts.description: The current place, a <span> with aria-current="page" in color.fg.default.

parts.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
parts.description: An aria-hidden <li> with a chevron or the given mark, in color.fg.subtle.

parts.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
parts.description: Three dots for collapsed places, with visually hidden text "More places".

states.name: hover
states.description: A link under the pointer: color.fg.default and underlined.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on a link: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

accessibility: The trail is a <nav> landmark named "Breadcrumb" holding an ordered list, so its length and order are announced.
The current place has aria-current="page" and is not a link; the separators are aria-hidden, so they are not read between items.
Links are in the tab order with a visible focus ring; a collapsed middle is a menu button with an accessible name.
Long names are truncated visually but keep their full text for assistive technology.

meta.example:
import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb";
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu";

/** The smallest useful Breadcrumb: two links and the current place. */
export function BreadcrumbMinimal() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#orders-prod">orders-prod</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#public">public</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>orders</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

/** A deep column path with the middle collapsed into a menu, and a slash separator. */
export function BreadcrumbRealistic() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#workspace">Workspace</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>/</BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger aria-label="Show collapsed places" className="flex rounded-xs outline-none focus-visible:outline-solid focus-visible:outline-[length:var(--by-ring-width)] focus-visible:outline-offset-[var(--by-ring-offset)] focus-visible:outline-ring">
              <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent>
              <DropdownMenuItem>orders-prod</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>public</DropdownMenuItem>
              <DropdownMenuItem>Tables</DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>/</BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#orders">orders</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>/</BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>created_at</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}
